faq.q: What is the maximum group size for a boat rental in Marbella in 2035?
faq.a: The maximum group size for most boats in our fleet is 12 passengers. Smaller vessels like the Dubhe (5 pax) or Mariah SX21 (5 pax) have lower limits. Always check the specific boat's capacity when booking.

faq.q: Can I rent a boat for a group larger than 12 people?
faq.a: No, our fleet does not accommodate groups larger than 12 passengers per boat. For larger parties, consider booking multiple boats or a catamaran like the Lagoon 380 (10 pax). Contact us via WhatsApp for custom solutions.

faq.q: Are children counted in the group size limit?
faq.a: Yes, children of all ages are counted towards the maximum passenger capacity for safety and insurance reasons. Each charter includes life jackets for all passengers.

faq.q: What is the smallest boat available for a small group?
faq.a: The smallest boat is the Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) or the Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax), both departing from Puerto Banús. They are ideal for couples or small families.

faq.q: How much does a boat rental cost for a group of 10?
faq.a: For a group of 10, the Astondoa 40 (9 pax) or Azimut 39 (11 pax) at €749/2h or €2,299/8h are great options. For 12 pax, choose the Azimut 58 Flybridge or Mangusta 80 (from €4,719/4h).

faq.q: Do all boats include a skipper?
faq.a: Yes, every charter includes a licensed skipper. You don't need a boating license. The skipper handles navigation and safety, letting you relax.

faq.q: What is included in the rental price?
faq.a: All charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). Some boats include extras like a jet ski.

faq.q: Can I book a boat for a half-day trip?
faq.a: Yes, we offer 2-hour, 4-hour, 6-hour, and 8-hour charters. Tier A boats have set prices for 2h and 8h. For other durations, contact us via WhatsApp for a quote.

data.body_html:
Planning a group outing on the Costa del Sol? Understanding marbella boat rental group size limits 2035 is essential for a smooth charter. Our fleet at Boat Rental Marbella offers vessels ranging from intimate 5-passenger speedboats to spacious 12-passenger yachts, all departing from Puerto Banús. Whether you're celebrating a birthday, hosting a corporate event, or enjoying a family day out, we have the right boat for your group.

Updated Group Size Limits for 2035

As of 2035, the maximum passenger capacity for our charter boats remains at 12 people for most vessels. This limit ensures safety, comfort, and compliance with Spanish maritime regulations. Smaller boats like the Dubhe (5 pax) and Mariah SX21 (5 pax) are perfect for couples or small families, while the Azimut 58 Flybridge (12 pax) and Mangusta 80 (12 pax) accommodate larger groups.

How Group Size Affects Pricing

Our pricing is transparent and based on boat tier. Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) cost €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours, including skipper, drinks, and IVA. Tier B boats like the Mangusta 80 start at €4,719 for a minimum 4-hour charter, which includes a free jet ski. For other boats, pricing is available on request via WhatsApp. Larger groups benefit from the per-person cost decreasing on bigger vessels.

Popular Routes for Groups

From Puerto Banús, you can cruise to iconic spots like the Golden Mile, Cala del Faro, or Cala Cortés. For a longer trip, head to Estepona or Sotogrande. The La Concha mountain provides a stunning backdrop. All routes are skipper-led, so you can focus on enjoying the Mediterranean sun.

Booking Tips for Large Groups

  • Book early to secure the boat that fits your group size.
  • For groups over 12, consider booking two boats or a catamaran like the Lagoon 380 (10 pax).
  • All charters include drinks and snacks; dietary requirements can be arranged.
  • Contact us via WhatsApp for custom itineraries or extended durations.

Why Choose Boat Rental Marbella?

We offer a modern fleet, licensed skippers, and all-inclusive pricing with no hidden fees. Every charter includes fuel, insurance, and Spanish VAT. Our base is in Puerto Banús, the heart of Marbella's luxury scene. For more details, explore our boat rental Marbella options.
